story.fullStory:
Salt-n-pepa's "Push It" reached #19 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Push It" is a song by American hip hop group Salt-N-Pepa.

It was first released in 1987 as the B-side of the single "Tramp".

The song has also been certified platinum by the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA).

The song peaked at #19 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 25 weeks on the chart.

Salt-N-Pepa (sometimes stylized as Salt 'N' Pepa) is an American hip hop group formed in New York City in 1985, that comprised Salt (Cheryl James), Pepa (Sandra Denton), and DJ Spinderella (Deidra Roper).

Their debut album, Hot, Cool & Vicious (1986), sold more than 1 million copies in the US, making them the first female rap act to receive both a gold and platinum certification by the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA).
Its lead single, "Push It", which was released in 1987 as the B-side to their single "Tramp", and peaked within the top 20 of the Billboard Hot 100.
